title: New Ebola Vaccines Enter Trial as Congo Faces Its Largest Outbreak
title_zh: 刚果迎史上最大埃博拉疫情，两款新疫苗加入临床试验
source_name: UN News — “Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial” (5 Nov 2026); WHO
summary_zh: 世界卫生组织 11 月 5 日宣布，两款专为邦迪布焦型埃博拉病毒设计的候选疫苗——牛津大学与印度血清研究所合作的 ChAdOx1，以及美国 Moderna 公司的 mRNA-1469——将加入刚果民主共和国的「Tumaini」（斯瓦希里语「希望」）多疫苗临床试验。截至 11 月 1 日，此次持续近六个月的疫情已超 1.05 万确诊、5126 例死亡，为该国史上最大规模。试验采用「环形接种」策略，优先覆盖确诊患者的接触者；专家称单靠疫苗不能终结疫情，但可能成为重要防控工具。
paragraphs: Two new Ebola vaccine candidates will join a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the World Health Organization announced on 5 November, as the country fights the largest Ebola outbreak in its history.

The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of the virus, has lasted nearly six months. As of 1 November, more than 10,500 people had been confirmed infected and 5,126 had died — roughly half of those who caught the disease.

The candidates are ChAdOx1, developed by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India, and mRNA-1469, developed by the US company Moderna. An independent WHO expert group recommended them for further testing this week. For the first time, vaccines designed specifically for Bundibugyo will be evaluated during an active outbreak.

WHO is supporting the Tumaini trial — Tumaini means “hope” in Swahili — which began on 23 October in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province and the epicentre of the outbreak. The Ervebo vaccine, already used against the Zaire species of Ebola, is also being studied to see whether it works against Bundibugyo. The two new candidates will enter the study after national approvals.

Tumaini tests several vaccines in one trial. It uses a ring-vaccination approach: health workers offer shots first to contacts of people with confirmed infection, because those contacts face the highest risk. WHO and partners pioneered this method during the West Africa Ebola outbreak a decade ago; a trial in Guinea then helped prove that Ervebo works.

WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the vaccines show “the power of science and partnership,” but stressed that vaccines alone will not end the outbreak. They could, however, become a powerful new tool for bringing it under control. Four vaccination rings are already running, more are being prepared, and research into other treatments continues.
paragraphs_zh: 世界卫生组织 11 月 5 日宣布，两款新的埃博拉候选疫苗将加入刚果民主共和国的一项临床试验；与此同时，该国正与本国史上最大规模的埃博拉疫情作斗争。
此次疫情由罕见的邦迪布焦型埃博拉病毒引起，已持续近六个月。截至 11 月 1 日，确诊感染超过 1.05 万人，死亡 5126 人——大约占感染者的一半。
两款候选疫苗分别是：牛津大学与印度血清研究所合作研发的 ChAdOx1，以及美国 Moderna 公司研发的 mRNA-1469。世卫组织一个独立专家组本周建议对它们作进一步临床评估。这将是首次在疫情进行期间，评估专为邦迪布焦病毒设计的疫苗。
世卫组织正在支持名为 Tumaini 的试验——Tumaini 在斯瓦希里语中意为「希望」。试验于 10 月 23 日在布尼亚启动，那里是伊图里省省会，也是本次疫情的震中。已用于抗击扎伊尔型埃博拉的 Ervebo 疫苗也在研究之中，以确认它对邦迪布焦型是否有效。两款新候选疫苗将在获得国家批准后进入试验。
Tumaini 在同一试验中测试多种疫苗。它采用「环形接种」做法：医务人员优先给确诊感染者的接触者接种，因为这些人风险最高。世卫组织及其合作伙伴十年前在西非埃博拉疫情中开创了这一方法；当时在几内亚的试验帮助证明了 Ervebo 的效力。
世卫组织总干事谭德塞·阿达诺姆·盖布雷耶苏斯表示，这些疫苗体现了「科学与伙伴关系的力量」，但他强调，单靠疫苗不能终结疫情。不过，它们可能成为控制疫情的有力新工具。目前已有四个接种环在运行，更多正在筹备，其他治疗手段的研究也在继续。

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
options: Ervebo has already ended every Ebola outbreak in Africa.
Two vaccines designed for Bundibugyo will join a Congo trial amid the country’s largest Ebola outbreak, using ring vaccination as an extra control tool.
Moderna has replaced all other Ebola vaccines worldwide.
The outbreak in the DRC ended on 1 November with fewer than 100 cases.
questions.explanation: 主旨：刚果正面临史上最大埃博拉疫情；两款专为邦迪布焦型设计的新候选疫苗将加入 Tumaini 试验，采用环形接种，作为控制疫情的新工具（而非单独终结疫情）。

evidence.quote: Two new Ebola vaccine candidates will join a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

questions.prompt: According to the passage, as of 1 November how many confirmed deaths had the outbreak caused?
questions.explanation: 细节：第二段写明截至 11 月 1 日确诊感染逾 1.05 万、死亡 5126 人。10,500 是确诊感染人数，不是死亡人数。

evidence.quote: As of 1 November, more than 10,500 people had been confirmed infected and 5,126 had died

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about ring vaccination from the passage?
options: It gives the first shots to people living farthest from any patient.
It was invented only after the Congo outbreak began in 2026.
It prioritises contacts of confirmed cases because they face the highest risk, and it helped prove Ervebo in Guinea a decade ago.
It means every citizen in the DRC must receive three vaccines at once.
questions.explanation: 推断/综合：文中说明环形接种优先给确诊患者的接触者（风险最高），且该方法十年前在西非几内亚试验中帮助证明了 Ervebo；并非 2026 年才发明，也不是全国全民三针同打。

evidence.quote: It uses a ring-vaccination approach: health workers offer shots first to contacts of people with confirmed infection, because those contacts face the highest risk.
